tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal lha mo'i las mtha' rims nad bzlog pa'i cho ga bzhugs so// 1$0000250

"$ ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das ma dud sol mar// phyag byas nad yams zlog pa bshad// ngar gyi nad bdag dred pa'i gzugs// ri rab zom la stegs bcas nas// bzlog pa'i phyag rgya byas pa cig /bang rim 'og mar rtsang dmar drug cu bzhi srin mo 'gros su btsugs /mtha' mar mtheb kyu mang pos bskor// 'go ba'i lha bdud gnod byed shwa rdel spung ba dang*// rang ngam yon bdag glud chen cig /gtor ma drug cu rtsa lnga dang*// glud chang srog chags gzugs srid dgu// ji snyed bkod cing 'bru sman dar// rin chen bza' btung tshogs tshad gzhug /khram shing gzer zhing skyes pa la pho shing bud med la mo shing g.yas g.yon du gzer mda' 'phang bsham// mar me gsum dang sha khrag zhag /rus pa dug dang gsur gyi dud// dri chu phag bya sbrul glang mi'i// snying gi mchod rdzas 'phreng bar spel// 'jigs shing skyi g.ya'i rol mo brdung*//1$0000250 bdag nyid lhar gsal mdun gyi gzugs// dud sol khros pa rtsang dmar rnams// zhing skyong pho nya drug cu bzhi// mtheb kyu nad kyi bdag mo'i khrom// mi sdug gzugs can nad rkyal 'byed| /stong gsum khyab pa tsam du blta// snying ga'i 'od kyis nad bdag rnams// bkug nas de la thim par bsam/ /hūm̐ kun bzang dbyings nas khyod bzhengs nas// khrag 'thung chen po'i tshogs dang rol// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig ma// che zhe chen mo dud sol ma// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer mdzad ma// do nub bskang zhing gshags pa'i phyir// 'bod kyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mthun rdzas tshogs pa'i gnas 'dir spyon// 'dod pa'i lcags kyu mi bzad pa| /dbang phyug chen po'i snying gar btab// lus phyed dbang du bsdus mdzad pa'i// dka' bzlog chen mo ri yi sras// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer mdzad ma// do nub= 'bod kyis= mthun rdzas= tshangs pa bdud dang brgya byin dang*// rgyal po sde bzhi lha min klu// gshin rje mi dbang thams cad kyis// mchod cing bstod pa'i srid rgyal ma// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer mdzad ma// do nub=

'bod kyis= mthun rdzas= dkar po lha yi dmag tshogs kyis// khyod kyi lte bar rdzongs bcas nas// nag po lha min thal bar btags| /rdzongs mo chen mo 'dod dbang ma// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer mdzad ma// do nub= 'bod kyis= mthun rdzas= rgya mtsho'i gting nas sku bskyod cing*// ri rab zom la stegs bcas nas// bar snang khams su thal mo rdeb// srid pa'i nad bdag chen mo ma// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer mdzad ma// do nub= 'bod= mthun rdzas= dur khrod chen po brgyad dang ni// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul skyong ba'i// pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhis bskor// yang bran nad kyi bdag mo'i tshogs// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer mdzad ma// do nub= 'bod kyis= mthun rdzas= 'khor bcas khyod rnams rgyab nas me// sreg pa'i bskal pa bas kyang 'tsher// mdun ni mi bzad khros pa'i gzugs| /mthong tshad snying khrag kha nas 'bo// lan chags= do nub= 'bod kyis= mthun rdzas= ral pa mtshan mo'i mun ltar gtibs// zhal gdangs mche ba ri ltar gnyer| /nad kyi kha rlangs sprin ltar 'tshubs// hūm̐ sgra 'brug gi skad ltar ldir// lan chags= do nub= 'bod kyis= mthun rdzas= srid gsum sha yis ma 'grangs par| /'gram pa gnyis ni gdub ltar 'khrol// khams gsum khrag gis ma ngoms par// ljags ni zhags pa lta bur bskyod// lan chags= do nub= 'bod kyis= mthun rdzas= spyan ni dmar po glog ltar 'khyom// shangs kyi khro gnyer grogs mkhar 'dra// snyan cha sbrul dang ro nyes brjid// smin ma me phung 'u ru ru// lan chags= do nub= 'bod kyis= mthun= nu ma g.yas pa phrag la gzar// g.yon pa rting pa'i phyogs su drud// ba spu dug gi tsher ma ste// khong nas spu gri'i char chen 'bebs// lan chags= do nub= 'bod kyis= mthun rdzas= zhabs brdebs gnam sa g.yo zhing 'phar// 'ur 'ur chem chem ldeg cing khol// sde brgyad thams cad dmag tu bsdu// 'jig rten phung byed drag shul can// lan chags sha 'khon gnyer mdzad ma// do nub bskang zhing gshags pa'i phyir// 'bod kyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mthun rdzas tshogs pa'i gnas 'dir spyon//

rdzas rnams chos nyid sngags rgyas sbyangs// 'dod dgu nam mkha'i mdzod du spel// kha 'bar ma yi sngags kyi mthar// bde gshegs bzhi mtshan brjod pas bsngo// che ba'i glud gtor chang bu re re/ gtso mo/ 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi la re re nas bsngo/ pho nya ma 'khor bcas la bsngo/ glud rdzas gzhan rnams thun mong du bsngo// 'khor rang bcas pa tshim par bsam/ /bh+yo de ring srid pa'i rgyal mo gson// 'dod pa khams kyi ma mo'i gtso| /nad bdag chen mo'i 'khor gyis bskor// sde brgyad thams cad pho nyar 'gyed// khyod la rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas kyi// lan chags thams cad bskang ba'i phyir// glud gtor 'dod dgu mchod pa 'bul// sha 'khon nyes pa mthol zhing bshags/ /hūm̐ glud chen ngar gyi mi bo che// rgyu ni rin chen brgyad la byas// zho sha'i snying la lung thang mig /mgron bu'i so la mu tig klad// zer mo'i sgro yi phon bzang skra// rkang pa g.yas pa thabs chen lcags// rkang g.yon shes rab zangs las byas// rnam shes lnga la 'bru sna lnga// sku gsung thugs la mar me gsum// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas// 'bras bu sku gsung thugs dang ldan// rten 'brel rnam shes lnga po 'dzom// dbang po lnga po 'di la tshang*// skye mched bcu gnyis dod par yod// phung po lngas ni shin tu brjid// khams chen bco brgyad mdzes par bdar// yon tan thams cad 'dus pa 'di'i| /lag pa g.yas su gser khur te// gser 'od rtag tu lams se lam// lag pa g.yon du g.yu khur te// g.yu 'od rtag tu khro lo lo// yon bdag lus las gos phud de| /gos de ngar gyi mi la bskon// gos bzang po cig lhubs se lhub// yon bdag ske nas rgyan bkrol te// rgyan de ngar gyi ske la btags// rgyan bzang po cig bkrag cing mtshar| /smra mkhas po cig ngag re 'jam// tshangs pa yi ni gsung dang ldan// 'gro mkhas po cig khyung chen 'gros// glang chen stabs su ldegs se ldeg

/mi yi glud du nga bzang zer| /kha nas su 'dod nga longs zer// mi bas glud bzang ya la la// rdza bas kha bro chi li li// glud 'di ma mo 'khor bcas bzhes// snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la bgos// bdud mda' de ni mthing nag la// sgro bzang mde'us rab brgyan te// yas bzhud nag po dgung sngon nas// mda' nag gi ni ltong la brgyan// pho bdud rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi// gnas su 'bul lo dkor du bsngo// skyes pa pho yi glud du 'bul// g.yu yi de ni mo 'phang la// gser gyi me long 'od du gsal// sna tshogs tshon dang rgyan gyis bkrag /mo bdud rgyal mo 'khor bcas la// gnas su 'bul lo dkor du bsngo// za ma mo yi glud du 'bul// gzhan yang 'bru la khrag gis sbrus// 'brang rgyas zur gsum ru tra'i snying*// ro bcud phun sum tshogs par ldan// ri rab chen po'i dpangs dang ldan// gzugs mdzes me tog spos chen dud// dri bzang sman dang 'bru sna dang*// la rdzas klung rdzas rin chen nor// stag gzig lpags pa gos dar dang*// gnam la 'phur dgu sa la rgyu// chu la 'phyo ba'i srog chags rnams// nam mkha'i mdzod las char du phab// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi /bla tshe srog dbugs glud du 'bul// mthun pa yi ni glud bzhes shig /'khor 'dir da nas gnod ma mdzad// de nas rgyan gzhi bting lha bdud gnyis// shwa brgyab lha rgyal lag tu dar 'phyar bsam nas su/ bdud gzugs ma mo'i mdun du bzhag /shwa rde nag po gtor/ dkar po spungs te lha gzugs rang gi khang stengs su'o/ kye snang zhing srid pa'i khams 'di na// ci las dbang che ma mo'i rgyal| /de ring rnal 'byor bdag la gson// bdag gis nyes na shwa 'di pham// ma nyes rgyal ba 'di gzigs nas// rgyan gzhi bting ba slar la bsdus// khram kha btab pa'i ri mo subs| /nag po'i rde'u spungs gnam la 'thor// bzung ba thong la chad pa 'thud// bcings pa khrol la mnan pa theg

/yo ba srongs la bub pa slongs/ /kye lha chen dbang phyug man chad nas// lag na gzhong thogs yan chad kyi// steng gi lha tshogs thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi ster khro tshul ston// steng gdon lag nas bla khug cig /bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// nam mkha'i dbyings su ci bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis snyabs thebs gcig /kye sa bdag lho 'phye man chad nas// the rang tshe la brku yan gyi// bar gyi 'dre srin thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs// phyag lan mi ster khro tshul ston// bar gdon lag nas bla khug cig /bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// bar snang stong par ci bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis snyabs thebs gcig /kyai| gshin rje'i rgyal po man chad nas// dmyal srung bshan pa gtum po yan// 'og gi 'chi bdag thams cad kyis// bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag byas kyang*// lha mos de la spyan mi gzigs| /phyag lan mi ster khro tshul ston// 'og gdon lag nas bla khug cig /bdag cag rnams la gnod byed de// sa 'og rim dgur ci bros kyang*// khyod kyi phyag gis snyabs thebs gcig /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin gyis// dus la bab nas tshe zad kyang*// lo brgya'i bar du bshol thob la// tshe ring bar chad med pa dang*// stobs dang mnga' thang rgyas par mdzod// sa phyogs 'di yi nad sol la// nad bdag khrom kha dgra la bsgyur// rims nad gnod pa de ru thong*// de nas ma mo'i khrom de dag zhal bsgyur sdang dgra'i yul song bsam// ngar gyi bud med kha bsgyur la// thun gyis brab cing 'di skad brjod/ hūm̐ lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la// gsang sngags dar kyang dam las g.yel// phal cher nag po'i las la spyod// de la srid pa'i rgyal mo 'khrugs// ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa// kha rlangs dkar po btang ba yis// mkha' la nad sprin dkar po chags// bud med dkar mos stong gsum khengs// de tshe nad kyi rkyal pa phye// 'dod chags kyis bskyed nad rigs ni// nyi khri chig stong de nas byung*// nad kyang lha mo khyod kyi 'phrul// dal kyang ma mo khyod kyi rdzu// de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gi

/rims kha chod la dal kha sgyur// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams dang*// rlung nad nyi khri chig stong bzlog /kye lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la// gsang sngags dar kyang dam las g.yel// phal cher nag po'i las la spyod// de la srid pa'i rgyal mo 'khrugs// ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa// kha rlangs dmar ser btang ba yis// mkha' la nad sprin dmar ser chags// bud med dmar ser stong gsum khengs// de tshe nad kyi rkyal pa phye// zhe sdang gis bskyed nad rigs ni// nyi khri chig stong de nas byung*// nad kyang lha mo khyod kyi 'phrul// dal kyang ma mo khyod kyi rdzu// de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /rims kha chod la dal kha bsgyur| /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams dang*// tshad nad nyi khri chig stong bzlog /kye lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la// gsang sngags dar kyang dam las g.yel// phal cher nag po'i las la spyod// de la srid pa'i rgyal mo 'khrugs// ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa// kha rlangs sngon po btang ba yis// mkha' la nad sprin sngon po chags// bud med sngon mos stong gsum khengs// de tshe nad kyi rkyal pa phye// gti mug gis bskyed nad rigs ni// nyi khri chig stong de nas byung*// nad kyang lha mo khyod kyi 'phrul// dal kyang ma mo khyod kyi rdzu// de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /rims kha chod la dal kha bsgyur// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams dang*// bad kan nyi khri chig stong bzlog /kye lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la// gsang sngags dar kyang dam las g.yel// phal cher nag po'i las la spyod// de la srid pa'i rgyal mo 'khrugs// ma mo khros pa'i rtags bstan pa| /kha rlangs rnam lnga btang ba yis// mkha' la nad sprin 'ja' ltar chags// bud med khra mos stong gsum khengs// de tshe nad kyi rkyal pa phye// dug gsum cha mnyam gyis bskyed nad| /nyi khri chig stong de nas byung*// nad kyang lha mo khyod kyi 'phrul// dal kyang ma mo khyod kyi rdzu// de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gi

/rims kha chod la dal kha bsgyur// mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams dang*// 'dus nad nyi khri chig stong bzlog /ma mo'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog /dregs pa bco brgyad gnod pa bzlog /khyad par 'gong po'i gnod pa rnams// sdang ba dgra yi steng du bsgyur// mi mthun rkyen rnams thams cad bsgyur// bud med nag mo bzhi yis bteg /sdang ba dgra yi yul phyogs bskyal// de ni pad dkar zhes bya ba'i// rigs sngags 'chang gis sbyar ba yin| /gces pa snying dang 'dra bar byos/// /mad+galaṃ// //
